text:
Before the meal, the tray held a bowl of mixed steamed vegetables (green beans, broccoli, cauliflower, snap peas) and a plate of mixed salad greens.

I estimated the vegetable bowl at about 120 g, since it looks like roughly 3/4 cup. At about 35 kcal per 100 g, that is around 42 kcal.

I estimated the salad greens at about 60 g, a large pile but light. At about 20 kcal per 100 g, that is around 12 kcal. There is no visible dressing.

Together that comes to about 180 g and 54 kcal.

In the second photo both dishes are almost empty, with only a few crumbs and leaves left. I therefore assumed nearly all of the food was eaten, which is about 175 g and 52 kcal.
